author: codex
description: Introduce deterministic percentage rollouts with stable subject buckets and rollout summaries. Client snapshots evaluate the same rollout rules as individual flag checks.

defects.mechanism: Snapshot replaces the repository’s bounded bulk query with a serial read per flag. A 100-flag client request produces 100 remote round trips instead of one.
The shared bucket algorithm returns values starting at zero. Inclusive comparison enables bucket zero at a zero-percent rollout and admits an extra bucket at other boundaries.
